chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The one who strives to provide for his family through lawful means is like a warrior in the path of Allah.

key_terms.اَلْكَادُّ: the one who exerts effort and works diligently
key_terms.حَلَالٍ: lawful and religiously permissible means of earning
key_terms.سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ: the path of Allah, meaning a cause devoted to Him
key_terms.عِيَالِهِ: his dependents or family members whom he supports

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for providing for one’s family through halal earnings in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that earning a lawful livelihood for one’s dependents carries immense spiritual merit. It elevates responsible family provision to the rank of jihad in the path of Allah, showing the dignity of halal work and care for one’s household.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: The one who strives to provide for his family through lawful means is like a warrior in the path of Allah (swt)."
